ITEM 1 | Large mound of off-white, opaque, lumpy solid pieces with a soft, slightly granular, fluffy surface, some pieces smooth and rounded, others broken into irregular clumps; covers the upper-left and center of the plate, roughly 9 cm across and 3 cm tall at the thickest point, holding its shape without flowing | 230
ITEM 2 | Glossy, translucent brown-olive gravy with a thin, flowing, sheen-covered consistency, pooling among and over the off-white pieces and spilling in a thin streak toward the lower right edge; covers roughly 30% of the central plate area, about 0.5 cm deep in pools | 90
ITEM 3 | Cubed pieces of orange-red vegetable with slightly glossy, firm, moist surfaces and a smooth cut face, each cube about 1.5 to 2 cm per side, arranged in a loose cluster along the lower center and lower right of the plate, with some pieces partly coated in gravy and a few darker brownish edges | 110
